name: flowtrace
description: Plan a change before any code, and explain one to someone who has never seen it. plan-flows reads the code the change touches, researches how it is best done, writes the plan and draws its page for you to read, answer and approve; plan-check then questions the approved plan; explain teaches how something works or asks you to choose, with one worked example traced through today and after.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a change before any code, explain how code works
interface.longDescription: plan-flows reads the code a change touches (the functions it edits, what calls them and the tests that run them), researches how it is best done, and draws the plan's page: each case the change handles differently, today beside after, and only the questions you alone can decide. plan-check then has a fresh subagent look for the edge cases and gaps the approved plan leaves, and asks you each one. explain teaches how something works or asks you to choose, with one worked example traced through today and after, and has a fresh subagent read the page cold. No skill commits or switches branches.
defaultPrompt: Plan this change with plan-flows before writing any code.
Run plan-check on the approved plan.
Explain how this works with explain.
